mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS rn, visit_data.* FROM ( SELECT v.member_no, m.member_id, m.name, m.nickname, m.role, v.ip_address, COUNT(*) AS visit_count, MIN(v.created_date) AS first_visit_date, MAX(v.created_date) AS last_visit_date, MAX(v.request_uri) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY v.created_date) AS last_request_uri, MAX(v.user_agent) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY v.created_date) AS last_user_agent FROM visit_log v LEFT JOIN member m ON v.member_no = m.no WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM member admin_member WHERE admin_member.no = v.member_no AND admin_member.role = 'ADMIN' ) AND ( #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR TO_CHAR(v.member_no) LIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR v.ip_address LIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR m.member_id LIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR m.name LIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR m.nickname LIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' ) GROUP BY v.member_no, m.member_id, m.name, m.nickname, m.role, v.ip_address ORDER BY MAX(v.created_date) DESC ) visit_data WHERE ROWNUM <= #{offset} + #{size} ) WHERE rn > #{offset}
